found: reconcile:items dry run on live data
description: Four sales of 15 Sept had lines worth twice their gross (qty was raised to 2 while the per-unit price stayed at the whole amount), so Units and profitability double counted them.
fix: Invariant lines = gross enforced in the RPC and server actions; reconcile:items --fix set unit price = gross / qty on the four rows and logged a system correction to audit_log.

found: flows-admin: reports revenue moved by the net amount
description: After saving an entry, Reports and Home kept the old numbers for up to 60 seconds: updateTag does not expire unstable_cache entries, so the ledger snapshot only refreshed on its safety-net timer.
fix: ledgerChanged now calls revalidateTag(tag, "max") as well as updateTag.

description: Ledger rows did not show the note, so an order id or a reference could not be found in the list.
fix: Note shown as a clamped line under the customer or category on both layouts.

found: matrix: route names from the brief
description: The names people reach for did not resolve; the pages live at /more/health, /more/deleted and /audit.
fix: Redirects added in next.config.ts.

description: Long product names in the phone cards ran into the next label; period labels wrapped.
fix: Units table rebuilt with short single-line period labels, sticky period and product columns and horizontal scroll inside the card.

description: Editing quantity on a single-line sale left the unit price unchanged, so lines disagreed with the gross.
fix: Amount and lines are linked: qty change keeps gross and recomputes the unit price, price change recomputes gross; line totals shown; server refuses mismatches with the difference.

description: The CSP sent upgrade-insecure-requests on plain http too, so on a local production preview every subresource was upgraded to https://localhost and failed with ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR in the console. Live (https) was unaffected.
fix: The upgrade directive is emitted only when the request is https (URL protocol or x-forwarded-proto).

description: With the amount still empty, choosing a product or quantity on a stock purchase (and on a sale) set the unit cost to zero instead of prefilling the amount from the standard cost times units, as v2.3 promised.
fix: With no amount yet the line's standard price or cost prefills the amount; once an amount exists the line follows it.

description: The QA payout probe confirmed the reconciliation proposal, which ticks the oldest waiting orders, so two of Mike's real 15 Sept orders (net 301.03 and 310.82) were marked received in bank by test payouts.
fix: Both settlements were restored to pending with no payout; the spec now names the probe customer and ticks only the probe row before confirming, so a real order can never be touched.

description: With Stock added to the header the wordmark, Add button, language toggle and Sign out wrapped onto two lines at 1440px; on phones the Purchase backlog pill on a Stock card was clipped by the card edge.
fix: Header right-hand group never wraps and never shrinks, the link row scrolls if it must, the signed-in label waits for xl; Stock card headers wrap the pill under the title when tight.

description: Audit rows written for system corrections (transfer reason, purchase product, orphan cleanup) rendered the raw key audit.entity.system_correction.
fix: Entity label added in EN and TH.

description: In quick-order mode the income form's sticky Save / Save and add another footer stayed visible under the order form.
fix: The footer hides in order mode like it does in transfer mode.

description: Mark cancelled opened its form inside the row link, and the form's click handler prevented the default of every click, so Cancel this order never submitted.
fix: The status control renders below the row link and only stops propagation; submit is prevented in the submit handler alone.

description: The header search input added in v2.8 squeezed the link row at 1440px so Reports was clipped and Insights and More scrolled out of view.
fix: The input shows from 2xl; below that a search icon opens the Search page.

description: The header nav was a sideways-scrolling strip: at 1024px the eight links plus the controls needed about 1050px of a 976px row, so the nav's scrollWidth exceeded its clientWidth.
fix: Search input removed for an overlay button, wordmark steps aside below 1280px, Insights, More, language and sign out fold into a More menu between 768 and 1024px.

description: Full product names wrapped to five lines and the Details link was clipped at the right edge.
fix: Short name and variant on one line, full name in the row detail and on hover, Details as a 44px icon; fixed column widths.

description: At 1440px the product cell wrapped and the customer cell carried the TikTok product text and the byline.
fix: Product on one line, buyer name only; note, byline and Mark cancelled in the row detail.

description: The Units table and the per-product strip scrolled sideways inside the card at every width.
fix: Column priorities and cards below 1024px; the strip wraps.

description: The thirteen-column editable review table and the nightly ready rows (min-width 640px) scrolled sideways.
fix: Review is one editable card per order at every width; ready rows follow the table rule with cards below 1024px.

description: While the sweep's probe rows were being removed through the service role (which does not expire the app's ledger cache), Data health briefly listed report-total mismatches whose labels are internal ids such as units.sold, and the no-raw-key check flagged them. It passes on a clean ledger (rerun: 16 of 16).
fix: None yet: a test artefact, but the ids are not plain words. Candidate for the next directive: translate the report-total labels.

description: Expenses saved from the new Expense sheet carry no platform, and the sheet took its default platform from the last row, so a new sale could start on Other and never show up when matching a TikTok payout.
fix: The default platform comes from the last sale.

description: The plain-word column label Profit before other costs was wider than its phone card and pushed past the screen.
fix: Labels wrap inside the card; the value keeps its width.

found: v3.0 revised, while executing the audit
description: Removing Home's transfers list would have left transfers sent as profit share with no page listing them, so they could not be opened or edited.
fix: My Balance lists every Money moved entry, each opening its edit page.

description: Migration 0026 added the Return cost category under an id that Registration and fees already held, so nothing was inserted and the loss on a return was dropped without a word.
fix: Migration 0027 adds it under a free id; applying a return without the category now stops with an error instead of skipping the expense.
